name: NahaLabs Engineering Control Loop
principle: Change code → automate verification → deploy → verify deployment → recover transient failures → alert on persistent failure.

evidence.deployment_alert: GitHub Issue: RailWatch deployment verification alert

rules: Never claim production health without a successful health contract check.
Never claim deployment success without matching the expected Git commit.
Every automated monitor must have a synthetic failure self-test.
Every browser smoke failure must preserve visual evidence when possible.
Keep demo traffic isolated from real telemetry and field systems.
Retry transient failures only within a bounded recovery policy.
Never automatically modify production data, secrets or deployment configuration.
Prefer free or open tooling before introducing paid infrastructure.
